svg.title: Here |1t⟩denotes the continuum single-quantum temporal-mode basis; the integral is an L2 wavepacket, not a distribution-valued state evaluated at a point. This is a signal-marker dilation of the abstract absorbing detector, not a microscopic model of photoelectron emission or a microtubule. The symbols 0, 1 label ready/triggered states, not their energy ordering. An explicit Markov dilation uses the coupling LX(t) = √
